represented._note: MUST equal this package's EarthAnimatedLayerIds (flow/scalar/point). The guard asserts set equality per slot.

pendingPortFromApp.reason: Surface wind-speed scalar overlay (|u,v| km/h, storm palette) landed in the app. Not yet ported to xyz-earth. CORRECTED 2026-09-16: the earlier reason here said it needs a representative scalar grid asset. It does not. In the app this layer has NO asset and NO object of its own - WindSpeedScalarFieldSource computes sqrt(u*u+v*v)*3.6 from the same wind u/v grid the flow already loads, and inherits that grid's source, vintage and isLive. This package already ships assets/earth/wind/wind-representative-climatology-v1.json and reads the same live GFS grid, so the port is a small derived source plus its palette and slot wiring, not a new data asset. The wrong reason made the gap look larger than it is and is why it sat here for two months.

bundledPointAssets._note: point layer id -> its bundled representative/clustered asset. The guard asserts every file exists (rename/delete a bundled asset -> red). satellites has no pointset file (client-propagated TLE orbits), so it is intentionally absent.
